Which of the following are the characteristics of the foreign exchange market?
I. It acts independently, and its activity will not have an impact on other financial markets.
II. It has no physical location, and transactions can be carried out 24 hours globally from Monday to Friday.
III. It provides a platform for currency speculators to speculate on the fluctuation of the currency value for profit.
IV. It enables international trades and foreign direct investments by enabling currency conversion.
Statements I, II, III and IV should be selected.
Only statements I, III and IV should be selected.
Only statements II, III and IV should be selected.
Only statements II and IV should be selected.

Answer: C — Only statements II, III and IV should be selected..
Statement-by-statement explanation:
I. Incorrect — this statement conflicts with or overstates the market-structure requirement: It acts independently, and its activity will not have an impact on other financial markets.
II. Correct — this statement is consistent with the market-structure requirement: It has no physical location, and transactions can be carried out 24 hours globally from Monday to Friday.
III. Correct — this statement is consistent with the market-structure requirement: It provides a platform for currency speculators to speculate on the fluctuation of the currency value for profit.
IV. Correct — this statement is consistent with the market-structure requirement: It enables international trades and foreign direct investments by enabling currency conversion.
Applied to this stem: Which of the following are the characteristics of the foreign exchange market?
